term.label: translational_frameshift

definition.text: The region of mRNA (not divisible by 3 bases) that is skipped or added during the process of translational frameshifting (GO:0006452), causing the reading frame to be different.

comments: Added synonym 'ribosomal_slippage' on Feb 1, 2021, a term in INSDC and GenBank. See GitHub Issue #522.
